name: MKT Quick Reorder for WooCommerce
author: MktFullService

sections.description:
MKT Quick Reorder for WooCommerce

Give your customers the ability to repeat any previous order with just one click from the “My Account > Orders” page. Perfect for stores with repeat purchases, subscription products, or frequently ordered items.

Features:

  • One-click reorder button in “My Account” → “Orders”
  • Works with simple and variable products
  • Automatic redirection to cart after adding items
  • Clean integration with WooCommerce
  • Translation ready (English and Spanish included)

Compatibility

Current version (1.0.x) supports:
* ✅ Classic My Account template (shortcode/PHP-based)
* ✅ WordPress 5.8 – 7.0+
* ✅ WooCommerce 6.0 – 9.0+

Not yet supported:
* ❌ WooCommerce Blocks (block-based My Account)
* ❌ Block-based themes (Twenty Twenty-Four, Twenty Twenty-Five, etc.)

We are actively working on adding full WooCommerce Blocks compatibility in an upcoming release (v1.1.0).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/mkt-quick-reorder-for-woocommerce
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. A “Quick Reorder” button will automatically appear in “My Account” → “Orders”
sections.faq:
Where does the button appear?

The button appears in the “Actions” column of the orders list in “My Account” → “Orders”.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin fully supports simple and variable products with all their attributes.

Can I customize the button text?

Yes, you can change the button text from the plugin settings page (Settings → MKT Quick Reorder for WooCommerce).

Does this work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Not yet. This version only supports the classic My Account template (shortcode/PHP). If you are using a block-based theme (like Twenty Twenty-Five) or the WooCommerce Blocks My Account, the “Quick Reorder” button will not appear. We are working on a new version with full Blocks compatibility.
